data.one_liner: Generates barcodes as image files using the Dart image library.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to draw various barcode formats onto an Image object and export it as PNG. Includes a command‑line tool for quick barcode generation.
use_when: You need to create barcode images on the server or in a CLI tool.
You want a pure‑Dart solution without native platform code.
avoid_when: You need real‑time barcode scanning or camera integration.
You require advanced UI widgets for displaying barcodes in Flutter.
strengths: No native dependencies; works on all Dart platforms.
Simple API that works with the popular image package.
weaknesses: Only generates static images; no widget for Flutter UI.
Limited to barcode formats supported by the underlying barcode package.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need image manipulation without barcode generation, the image package alone suffices.
